definitions.explanation: Dark, heavy clouds that produce rain.

examples.japanese: {雨雲|あまぐも}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
{雨雲|あまぐも}が{近|ちか}づいてきた。
{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}によると、{午後|ごご}から{雨雲|あまぐも}が{出|で}るらしい。
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, rain clouds will appear from the afternoon.

notes:
Dark, heavy clouds that bring rain. A compound of {雨|あめ} (rain) and {雲|くも} (cloud), with {雲|くも} voiced to ぐも through rendaku.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨雲|あまぐも}が{広|ひろ}がる: rain clouds spread
- {雨雲|あまぐも}が{近|ちか}づく: rain clouds approach
- {雨雲|あまぐも}レーダー: rain cloud radar (a popular weather app feature)
- {厚|あつ}い{雨雲|あまぐも}: thick rain clouds

RELATED WORDS:
- {入道雲|にゅうどうぐも}: cumulonimbus cloud; towering thundercloud
- {曇|くも}り: cloudy weather
- {雷雲|らいうん}: thundercloud
